title: Compose state checklist
body: Hoist state, use rememberSaveable for config changes, collect StateFlow with lifecycle.

title: Room migration notes
body: Export schemas, write a migration test for every version bump.

title: Release day runbook
body: Build AAB, run internal track, watch vitals for 24h before rollout.

title: Game loop timing
body: Clamp dt to 33ms max so physics never explodes after a hitch.

title: Navigation patterns
body: Type-safe routes, one back stack owner, deep links tested from adb.

title: Apollo checklist (sample)
body: A fictional checklist used only as sample data for tests.

title: Coroutines traps
body: Never GlobalScope. structured concurrency, supervisor only where failure is isolated.

title: Accessibility pass
body: 48dp targets, content descriptions, test with TalkBack and font scale 1.3.

title: Offline-first design
body: Room is source of truth, network only refreshes it.

title: Baseline profile results
body: Regenerate after big Compose changes, measure with Macrobenchmark.

title: Network security config
body: HTTPS only, pin only with a backup pin and an expiry plan.

title: Kernel-style code review
body: Small diffs, clear messages, no unrelated refactoring.

title: Chip design trivia
body: Sample note with no real-world use beyond fixtures.

title: Play data safety draft
body: List every data type collected, why, and whether it is shared.

title: Sprite batching idea
body: Draw all balls in one Canvas pass, keep state outside the draw scope.
